d.ko: A one-route standalone expansion for the fan-favorite visual novel Mashiroiro Symphony. The main character's classmate Sana finally takes the spotlight with a new story and new CGs by artist Tsubasu Izumi!
d.en: A one-route standalone expansion for the fan-favorite visual novel Mashiroiro Symphony. The main character's classmate Sana finally takes the spotlight with a new story and new CGs by artist Tsubasu Izumi!
d.zh: 大受欢迎的视觉小说《纯白交响曲》的追加路线。 主角的同学纱凪终于获得聚焦，在和泉Tsubasu绘制的新CG加持下，她将展开新的故事！
